info.title: ModelRunner Platform API
info.description: Platform APIs: model catalog, search and collections; model pricing rate cards; file uploads and your asset library; account balance and usage; and webhook delivery management. Catalog reads are public; account-scoped routes authenticate with your API key (`Authorization: Key <MODELRUNNER_KEY>`). Request lifecycle endpoints (submit/status/result and the request list) live on the queue host — see the Queue API reference.

Model.description: A catalog model. Provider-facing internals (provider schemas, request/extraction config, field mappings) are never present on public responses; `providerRequestConfig` appears only as `{"apiType": "chat_completions"}` on chat-servable models. Additional descriptive fields may appear beyond those listed.

alias.description: May contain slashes. The user-facing endpoint is `ownerName/alias`.

schema.description: OpenAPI-style input/output schema for the model (`components.schemas.Input` / `Output`). The same document `GET /models/{owner}/{alias}/openapi.json` serves standalone.

averageCost.description: Observed average cost of one run (decimal string), where tracked.

examples.description: Curated example request ids — fetch via the model detail page.

providerRequestConfig.description: Public callers see `{"apiType": "chat_completions"}` on chat-servable models, null otherwise.

ModelRateCard.description: Mode-specific rate card, discriminated on `pricingMode`. Deliberately structured rather than flattened to a single unit price: each mode's own fields carry its rates, so no mode can be misread through another's lens. All rates are decimal strings in USD.

pricePerOutputSecond.description: Price per second of generated media.

megapixelPricing.description: Tiered (`maxMegapixels` thresholds) or exact (`megapixels` keys) price table with an optional `defaultPrice`.

tokenPricing.description: Per-1M-token rates by bucket (`text.input`, `text.output`, `cachedInput`, …), optional rounding increment, and an optional `displayExample` for non-text outputs.

pricingRules.description: Input/output-conditional overrides of the rate the rateCard names: `dimensions` resolved from the request select a `rate` from `rules`, with a `default` fallback. When present, the rateCard carries the base rate.

averageCost.description: Observed average cost of one run (decimal string), where the catalog tracks it.

endpoint.description: `ownerName/alias` — the value you submit requests to.

rootModel.description: Model family key — results sharing it are variants (price/speed tiers).

defaultBaseModel.description: Wrappers only: the default base model's endpoint.

score.description: Full-text rank, comparable across models and wrappers.

matchedOn.description: Which fields matched the query ('fulltext' = stemmed match only).

examplePrompts.description: Real prompts from curated example runs.

id.description: Also the `webhook-id` header value — your dedupe key.

total.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

Tag.description: A tag in your personal tag collection. Tags are per-account and never shared.

TagWithCount.description: A tag plus how many of your files carry it.

File.description: One asset in your library — a file you uploaded or an output a model produced for you.

url.description: Canonical public URL on the media domain. Pass this to any model input that accepts a file.

thumbnailUrl.description: Lightweight generated preview (`.webp` image / `.webm` motion preview) for request outputs. Null for uploads, audio, and older rows — fall back to `url`.

source.description: How the row was created: `upload` (you uploaded it), `request_output` (a model produced it), `external` (a URL recorded from elsewhere).

isFavorited.description: Whether you have favorited this file.

tags.description: Tags you have applied to this file.

FileRequestLink.description: A link between a file and a request that used or produced it.

role.description: `input` — the file was passed into the request; `output` — the request produced it.

position.description: Index within that role, for multi-file requests.

FileWithRequests.description: A file plus its request linkages.

url.description: Canonical public URL on the media domain. Pass this to any model input that accepts a file.

thumbnailUrl.description: Lightweight generated preview (`.webp` image / `.webm` motion preview) for request outputs. Null for uploads, audio, and older rows — fall back to `url`.

source.description: How the row was created: `upload` (you uploaded it), `request_output` (a model produced it), `external` (a URL recorded from elsewhere).

isFavorited.description: Whether you have favorited this file.

tags.description: Tags you have applied to this file.

requests.description: Every request this file is linked to, as input or output.

FileFacets.description: Counts per asset bucket under the active type/tag/search filters.

ModelFacets.description: Catalog counts by modality pair and capability, under the same filters as List Models.

CollectionModelSummary.description: The trimmed model card returned inside a collection. Fetch the full record from `GET /models` or the per-model OpenAPI document.

alias.description: May contain slashes. The endpoint is `ownerName/alias`.

sortBy.description: How the collection orders its members for display.

modelCount.description: Number of models returned in `models` — private members are withheld and are not counted.

get.description: Paginated public model catalog with free-text search and structured filters. Private models are unlisted here (direct reads by endpoint still resolve them — 'private' means unlisted, not access-controlled).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search over name, alias, description, owner, category, tags.

parameters.name: inputModality
parameters.description: e.g. text, image, video, audio.

get.description: Counts of catalog models grouped by input→output modality pair and by capability, under the same filters as List Models. Only public models are counted, so the totals always agree with what List Models returns.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Same free-text search as List Models.

get.description: The curated featured set, unpaginated. Same public projection as List Models — provider internals are never included.

Batch pricing read: a versioned, `pricingMode`-discriminated rate card per endpoint. Repeat the `endpoint` parameter for a batch (aliases may contain slashes, so endpoints are never comma-joined). Endpoints that resolve to no priceable model are reported under `notFound` instead of failing the batch.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.description: `ownerName/alias`, repeated. At most 50 per request.

200.description: Rate cards for the resolved endpoints.

get.description: The model's machine-readable OpenAPI document: its input schema (`components.schemas.Input`), output schema, and endpoint paths. What code generators and AI assistants should consume before calling a model. `alias` may itself contain slashes.

200.description: An OpenAPI 3 document describing the model.

get.description: Unified free-text search across models and wrappers, with match provenance, comparable relevance scores, pricing context, and real example prompts. Recall-first: prefer 2-4 plain keywords over long natural-language phrases.
Published model collections — curated groupings of related models. Private member models are withheld, and `modelCount` counts only the models actually returned.
One published collection with its member models. Unpublished collections are not readable here.

404.description: Unknown slug, or the collection is not published.

post.description: Start a single-part upload. Returns a presigned `upload_url` to `PUT` the bytes to, and the canonical `file_url` to pass as a model input. The file row is created now, so an upload you never complete leaves a row whose `file_url` 404s. Walkthrough: [File uploads](/guides/file-uploads).

parameters.name: X-Modelrunner-Object-Lifecycle-Preference
parameters.description: JSON object setting an expiry for the stored object, e.g. `{"expiration_duration_seconds": 3600}`. The countdown starts at upload time. See the [data retention guide](/guides/data-retention).

file_name.description: Original filename. Preserved, with a random prefix.

content_type.description: MIME type. Send the same value as `Content-Type` on the `PUT`.

relay.description: Also mint `relay_upload_url` — a first-party `PUT` URL on this API host that streams to the same object server-side. For clients whose egress allowlist rejects the raw AWS S3 host.

upload_url.description: Presigned S3 `PUT` URL. Valid 5 minutes. Send no `Authorization` header — the URL carries its own credentials.

file_url.description: Canonical public URL. Usable as model input once the bytes land.

relay_upload_url.description: Present only when `relay: true`. Same 5-minute window; `PUT` the raw bytes here instead if the S3 host is blocked.

post.description: Start a multipart upload for a large file. `fileUrl` is the canonical public URL — keep it; it is the one to pass as a model input once the upload completes.

fileUrl.description: Canonical public URL for the finished object.

get.description: Presign one part of an in-flight multipart upload. Part numbers start at 1; every part except the last must be at least 5 MiB. Capture the `ETag` response header from each part `PUT` — Complete Multipart Upload needs it.

post.description:
Assemble the uploaded parts into one object and record the file. This is where the multipart file row is created, so an object-lifecycle header belongs on this call rather than the initiate.

The `fileUrl` returned here is S3's native location, which is **not** publicly readable. Use the `fileUrl` from Initiate Multipart Upload as the model input.

parameters.name: X-Modelrunner-Object-Lifecycle-Preference
parameters.description: JSON object setting an expiry for the stored object, e.g. `{"expiration_duration_seconds": 3600}`. The countdown starts at upload time. See the [data retention guide](/guides/data-retention).

etag.description: The `ETag` header from that part's `PUT`, without surrounding quotes.

fileUrl.description: S3's native location URL for the assembled object — not the public URL. See the description.

post.description:
Send a file inline as small base64 chunks, assembled server-side. This exists for clients that can reach neither the S3 host nor the relay — prefer Initiate Upload everywhere else.

Omit `upload_id` on the first chunk; the response mints one to thread through the rest. Set `is_last_part` on the final chunk. Chunks may arrive out of order; the upload completes when every index from 0 to the last is present, and the response then carries `file_url`. Limits: 1 MiB decoded per chunk, 50 MiB per upload, 10,000 parts, and abandoned parts are discarded after an hour.

`expected_decoded_bytes` is the truncation guard: a mismatch rejects that chunk alone, so resend only that `part_index`.

upload_id.description: Omit on the first chunk; echo the minted value on every later chunk.

is_last_part.description: Exactly one chunk may set this.

base64.description: This chunk's bytes, base64-encoded. ~32–48 KB per chunk works well.

expected_decoded_bytes.description: Decoded byte length of this chunk.

sha256.description: Optional hex SHA-256 of this chunk's decoded bytes.

file_sha256.description: Optional hex SHA-256 of the whole assembled file, checked at completion.

missing_parts.description: Present once the final part has been seen and gaps remain.

file_url.description: Present only on the chunk that completes the upload.

400.description: Chunk failed validation — length mismatch, hash mismatch, or a cap exceeded.

put.description: First-party fallback for the presigned `PUT`: send the raw bytes here and they are streamed to storage server-side. Call this only with the `relay_upload_url` returned by Initiate Upload with `relay: true` — the `upload_token` in that URL is the sole credential, is bound to one object key and content type, and expires in 5 minutes. Do not send an `Authorization` header. Maximum 200 MiB.

parameters.name: upload_token
parameters.description: Taken verbatim from `relay_upload_url`. Not an API key, and not usable on any other route.

file_url.description: Canonical public URL — the same `file_url` the initiate returned.

400.description: Empty body, or larger than 200 MiB.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or non-upload token.

get.description:
Your asset library, newest first — every file you uploaded plus every output a model produced for you. Always scoped to the authenticated account.

Files reach this library from three places: [uploads](/guides/file-uploads), request outputs at finalization, and inputs you pass to a request (which links the upload you already own). URLs pasted from elsewhere are not recorded.

parameters.name: sources
parameters.description: Repeat to union buckets. `upload` — files you uploaded; `output` — files a model produced for you; `input` — your uploads that a request consumed. `external` rows are excluded unless you ask for them explicitly.

parameters.name: tagIds
parameters.description: Repeat for multiple tags.

parameters.name: tagRule
parameters.description: How multiple `tagIds` combine.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match over the storage key and URL.

parameters.name: mimeTypePrefix
parameters.description: e.g. `image/`, `video/`, `audio/`.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Only files linked to this request.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Only files linked in this role.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter on the stored `source` column. Prefer `sources`, which matches the buckets in File Facets.

get.description: How many of your files fall in each bucket, under the type, tag, and search filters you pass. Bucket filters (`sources`, `favoritesOnly`) are what is being counted, so they are ignored here.

parameters.name: tagIds
parameters.description: Repeat for multiple tags.

parameters.name: tagRule
parameters.description: How multiple `tagIds` combine.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring match over the storage key and URL.

parameters.name: mimeTypePrefix
parameters.description: e.g. `image/`, `video/`, `audio/`.

get.description: Look a file up by its public URL when you hold the URL but not the id — for example to check whether an output you are displaying is one of yours, and whether you have favorited it.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The canonical `file_url`, matched exactly.

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

get.description: One file with every request it is linked to, as input or output.

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: Removes the file from your library and drops its request links. The stored object is **not** deleted and its URL keeps resolving — and once the record is gone there is nothing left to find the object by, so set an expiry at [upload time](/guides/data-retention) for anything you want cleaned up automatically.

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

post.description: Marks the file as a favorite. Idempotent. A favorited file is also exempt from retention sweeps — see [data retention](/guides/data-retention).

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: Removes the favorite. Idempotent — unfavoriting a file that was not favorited succeeds.

post.description: Tags one of your files. Pass `tagId` for an existing tag, or `name` to create-or-reuse one by case-insensitive name — exactly one of the two. Tagging also exempts a file from retention sweeps.

400.description: Neither or both of `tagId` and `name` were provided.

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

delete.description: Unassigns a tag from a file. Idempotent, and leaves the tag itself in place.

404.description: No such file, or it belongs to another account — the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

get.description: Your tags, each with the number of your files carrying it.

post.description: Creates a tag. Idempotent on the case-insensitive name — an existing tag with that name is returned unchanged.

delete.description: Deletes the tag and unassigns it from every file. The files themselves are untouched.

404.description: No such tag on this account.

get.description: The authenticated account's current credit balance, as an exact decimal string. An account that has never been credited reads as `"0"`.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.

get.description: Spend and request statistics for the authenticated account over a trailing window. `totalSpent` sums what was actually charged (exact decimal string); `successRate` excludes failed generations (`billingStatus: 'failed'`), not just failed requests.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.

get.description: The account's webhook signing secret (`{ "key": "whsec_…" }`), used to verify Standard-Webhooks signatures on deliveries. Created on first read.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.

post.description: Rotates the signing secret and returns the new value. Deliveries signed with the old secret stop verifying immediately.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.

get.description: The account's webhook delivery log, newest first.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.

post.description: Re-queues one delivery for another attempt with a fresh signature. Owner-only.

403.description: Authenticated, but not allowed for this caller.
